facts.name: Shadow Account Guarantee

facts.name: Account Value Definition
facts.sentence: Account Value refers to the actual policy accumulation value.

facts.name: Monthly Interest Crediting
facts.sentence: Account Value is determined by crediting interest each month.

facts.name: Monthly Charge Deduction
facts.sentence: Account Value is determined by deducting charges each month.

facts.name: Hypothetical Accumulation Account
facts.sentence: A Shadow Account is a hypothetical accumulation account.

facts.name: Shadow Account Purpose
facts.sentence: The Shadow Account is used solely to test whether the Secondary Guarantee is in effect.

facts.name: Shadow Account No Cash Value
facts.sentence: The Shadow Account has no cash value.

facts.name: Shadow Account Access Restriction
facts.sentence: The Shadow Account cannot be accessed.

facts.name: Level Monthly Premium Definition
facts.sentence: Shadow Account Premium refers to the level monthly premium.

facts.name: Shadow Account Premium Location
facts.sentence: Shadow Account Premium is specified on the Policy Data Page.

facts.name: Cumulative Shadow Account Payment
facts.sentence: Shadow Account Premium must be paid on a cumulative basis.

facts.name: Shadow Account Maintenance Requirement
facts.sentence: Shadow Account Premium is required to maintain the Shadow Account in force.

facts.name: Fixed Shadow Account Rate
facts.sentence: Shadow Account Crediting Rate is a fixed annual rate of 3.75%.

facts.name: Exclusive Use of Crediting Rate
facts.sentence: Shadow Account Crediting Rate is used exclusively in Shadow Account calculations.

facts.name: Guaranteed Crediting Rate
facts.sentence: Shadow Account Crediting Rate is guaranteed.

facts.name: Guaranteed Maximum COI Rates
facts.sentence: Shadow Account COI Rate refers to the guaranteed maximum COI rates.

facts.name: Shadow Account COI Usage
facts.sentence: Shadow Account COI Rates are used in Shadow Account calculations.

facts.name: COI Rate Separation
facts.sentence: Shadow Account COI Rates are separate from current COI rates.

facts.name: Policy Continuation Guarantee
facts.sentence: Secondary Guarantee (SG) is a guarantee that the policy remains in force.

facts.name: Policy Continuation via Shadow Account
facts.sentence: The policy remains in force under the Secondary Guarantee so long as the Shadow Account has a positive value.

facts.name: Policy Continuity via Secondary Guarantee
facts.sentence: The policy remains in force under the Secondary Guarantee regardless of the actual Account Value.

facts.name: Flexible Premium Payment Timing
facts.sentence: Premiums may be paid at any time.

facts.name: Minimum Premium Payment
facts.sentence: The minimum amount per premium payment is $100.

facts.name: Annual Premium Cap
facts.sentence: The annual maximum premium payment is $120,000.

facts.name: Annual Premium Compliance
facts.sentence: The annual maximum premium payment complies with IRC §7702.

facts.name: Premium Expense Load
facts.sentence: A premium expense load of 3.5% applies to each premium payment.

facts.name: Premium Allocation to Actual Account
facts.sentence: Premiums are applied directly to the actual Account Value.

facts.name: Shadow Account Credit Calculation
facts.sentence: The Shadow Account credits an amount equal to 96.5% of the premium paid.

facts.name: Shadow Account Load Assumption
facts.sentence: The Shadow Account credit calculation assumes a 3.5% premium expense load.

facts.name: Secondary Guarantee Dependency
facts.sentence: The Secondary Guarantee depends on the Shadow Account balance, not the actual Account Value.

facts.name: Secondary Guarantee Activation Risk
facts.sentence: Paying only the planned premium does not guarantee that the Secondary Guarantee remains active.

facts.name: Secondary Guarantee Inactivation Risk
facts.sentence: The Secondary Guarantee can become inactive if premiums are skipped.

facts.name: Late Premiums & SG Inactivation
facts.sentence: The Secondary Guarantee can become inactive if premiums are paid late.

facts.name: Shadow Account Testing
facts.sentence: On each Monthly Deduction Date, the Shadow Account Value is tested.

facts.name: Shadow Account Definition Reference
facts.sentence: The Shadow Account Value used in testing is defined in Article 11.

facts.name: Secondary Guarantee Activation Condition
facts.sentence: If the Shadow Account Value is greater than or equal to $0, the Secondary Guarantee is active.

facts.name: Shadow Account Threshold
facts.sentence: If the Shadow Account Value is less than $0, the Secondary Guarantee is inactive.

facts.name: Secondary Guarantee Inactivation Consequence
facts.sentence: When the Secondary Guarantee is inactive, the policy becomes subject to ordinary lapse provisions.

facts.name: Monthly Deduction Schedule
facts.sentence: Monthly deductions occur on the 3rd of each month.

facts.name: Monthly COI Charge Deduction
facts.sentence: On the 3rd of each month, the Current Cost of Insurance charge is deducted from the actual Account Value.

facts.name: Monthly Admin Fee Deduction
facts.sentence: On the 3rd of each month, an administrative fee of $9.00 is deducted from the actual Account Value.

facts.name: Monthly Service Charge Deduction
facts.sentence: On the 3rd of each month, a policy service charge of $0.07 per $1,000 Specified Amount is deducted from the actual Account Value.

facts.name: Policy Service Charge Duration
facts.sentence: The policy service charge applies during the first 15 policy years.

facts.name: Loan Interest Deduction
facts.sentence: On the 3rd of each month, outstanding loan interest is deducted from the actual Account Value.

facts.name: COI Rates Basis
facts.sentence: Current Cost of Insurance rates are based on the 2017 CSO Table.

facts.name: Preferred Plus COI Classification
facts.sentence: Current Cost of Insurance rates use the Preferred Plus classification.

facts.name: COI Rate Adjustment Rights
facts.sentence: We may change current Cost of Insurance rates.

facts.name: COI Rate Basis
facts.sentence: Current COI rates are based on the 2017 CSO Table.

facts.name: COI Rates Based on Preferred Plus
facts.sentence: Current COI rates use the Preferred Plus classification.

facts.name: Prospective COI Rate Adjustments
facts.sentence: We may change current COI rates prospectively.

facts.name: COI Rate Change Notice Requirement
facts.sentence: A change in current COI rates requires 60 days' written notice.

facts.name: COI Rate Adjustment Limits
facts.sentence: Changes to current COI rates are subject to guaranteed maximums in the COI Schedule.

facts.name: Current Assumption UL Methodology
facts.sentence: This policy uses Current Assumption UL methodology.

facts.name: Interest Rate Impact on Growth
facts.sentence: Actual Account Value growth depends on the current credited interest rate.

facts.name: Interest Rate Flexibility
facts.sentence: The current credited interest rate may change over time.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Illustrations
facts.sentence: Illustrated values in the policy illustration are not guarantees.

facts.name: Monthly Interest Crediting
facts.sentence: Interest is credited monthly under Article 4.

facts.name: Guaranteed Minimum Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The guaranteed minimum interest rate is 2.00% per annum.

facts.name: Current Interest Rate Set
facts.sentence: The current interest rate is 5.25% per annum.

facts.name: Monthly Rate Declaration
facts.sentence: The current interest rate is declared on the first business day of each month.

facts.name: Interest Rate Stability Goal
facts.sentence: We aim to maintain stability in the current interest rate.

facts.name: Interest Rate Change Flexibility
facts.sentence: We may change the current interest rate at any time.

facts.name: Persistency Bonus Eligibility
facts.sentence: A persistency bonus of +0.25% per annum applies to policies in force for 10 or more years.

facts.name: Persistency Bonus Eligibility
facts.sentence: The persistency bonus applies only when there has been no lapse during the 10-year period.

facts.name: Persistency Bonus Eligibility
facts.sentence: The persistency bonus applies only when the Account Value exceeds $50,000.

facts.name: Persistency Bonus Discontinuation
facts.sentence: The persistency bonus may be discontinued prospectively.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit – Option A
facts.sentence: Option A provides a Level death benefit.

facts.name: Option A Death Benefit Rule
facts.sentence: Under Option A, the death benefit equals the Specified Amount.

facts.name: IRC §7702 Minimum Requirement
facts.sentence: The death benefit under Option A is subject to the IRC §7702 corridor minimum.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payable Regardless of Guarantee Status
facts.sentence: Death benefit is payable even if the Secondary Guarantee is inactive.

facts.name: Death Benefit Eligibility
facts.sentence: Death benefit is payable as long as the policy remains in force.

facts.name: Death Benefit Increase Request
facts.sentence: The owner may request an increase in the death benefit.

facts.name: Death Benefit Increase Requirement
facts.sentence: An increase in the death benefit requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Death Benefit Eligibility
facts.sentence: Death benefit is payable when the policy is in force.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payable Regardless
facts.sentence: Death benefit is payable regardless of whether the Secondary Guarantee is active.

facts.name: Specified Amount Increase Request
facts.sentence: The owner may request an increase in the Specified Amount.

facts.name: Increase Requires Insurability Proof
facts.sentence: An increase in the Specified Amount requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Specified Amount Decrease Request
facts.sentence: The owner may request a decrease in the Specified Amount.

facts.name: Minimum Face Amount Constraint
facts.sentence: A decrease in the Specified Amount cannot reduce the remaining face amount below $50,000.

facts.name: Specified Amount Change Fee
facts.sentence: A $75 administrative fee applies to any change in the Specified Amount.

facts.name: Shadow Account Recalibration
facts.sentence: A decrease in the Specified Amount triggers a recalculated Shadow Account.

facts.name: Specified Amount Decrease Extends SG
facts.sentence: A decrease in the Specified Amount may extend the duration of the Secondary Guarantee.

facts.name: Specified Amount Decrease Impact
facts.sentence: A decrease in the Specified Amount may shorten the duration of the Secondary Guarantee.

facts.name: Minimum Partial Withdrawal
facts.sentence: The minimum partial withdrawal amount is $500.

facts.name: Maximum Partial Withdrawal Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum partial withdrawal amount is the Account Value minus ($500 plus outstanding loans).

facts.name: Partial Withdrawal Fee (Years 1–7)
facts.sentence: Each partial withdrawal made during years 1 through 7 incurs a $30 fee.

facts.name: Fee-Free Withdrawals After Year 8
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals made in year 8 or later incur no fee.

facts.name: Withdrawal Impact on Actual Account Value
facts.sentence: Withdrawals reduce the actual Account Value.

facts.name: Withdrawals Not Impact Shadow Account
facts.sentence: Withdrawals do not reduce the Shadow Account balance.

facts.name: Policy Lapse from Zero Account Value
facts.sentence: If the Account Value reaches zero due to withdrawals, the policy lapses.

facts.name: Policy Lapse on Zero Account Value
facts.sentence: The policy lapses regardless of the Shadow Account's status if the Account Value drops to zero from withdrawals.

facts.name: Monthly Withdrawal Limit
facts.sentence: No more than one partial withdrawal is allowed per calendar month.

facts.name: Maximum Loan Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum policy loan amount is 90% of the current Account Value.

facts.name: Variable Interest Rate (Years 1–10)
facts.sentence: The loan interest rate for years 1–10 is variable.

facts.name: Loan Interest Rate Calculation
facts.sentence: The loan interest rate for years 1–10 equals the 10-year Treasury yield plus 1.00 percentage point.

facts.name: Loan Rate Floor (Years 1–10)
facts.sentence: The loan interest rate for years 1–10 has a minimum floor of 4.00%.

facts.name: Annual Interest Rate Adjustment
facts.sentence: The loan interest rate for years 1–10 is adjusted annually.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Rate After Year 10
facts.sentence: After year 10, a fixed loan interest rate option becomes available.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate Post-Year 10
facts.sentence: The fixed loan interest rate after year 10 is 4.50% per annum.

facts.name: Loan Reduces Actual Account Value
facts.sentence: Policy loans reduce the actual Account Value.

facts.name: Loan-induced policy lapse risk
facts.sentence: Policy loans can cause the policy to lapse if the Account Value is insufficient to cover monthly deductions.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Despite Active SG
facts.sentence: A policy can lapse despite the Secondary Guarantee being active if account value is too low to cover loan-related deductions.

facts.name: Fixed Option Rate
facts.sentence: A fixed option is available at 4.50% per annum.

facts.name: Loans Reduce Actual Account Value
facts.sentence: Policy loans reduce the actual Account Value.

facts.name: Loan Risk and Lapse Condition
facts.sentence: Policy loans may cause a policy lapse if the Account Value is insufficient to cover monthly deductions.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Despite Active SG
facts.sentence: A policy can lapse even if the Special Guarantee (SG) is active.

facts.name: Loan Impact on Shadow Account
facts.sentence: Loans do not affect Shadow Account calculations.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Calculation
facts.sentence: Cash Surrender Value equals Account Value minus Surrender Charge minus Outstanding Loans.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Basis
facts.sentence: The Surrender Charge Schedule is based on the initial Specified Amount.

facts.name: Year 1 Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: In Year 1, the Surrender Charge is 7.0% of the Initial Specified Amount.

facts.name: Year 2 Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: In Year 2, the Surrender Charge is 6.5% of the Initial Specified Amount.

facts.name: Year 3 Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: In Year 3, the Surrender Charge is 6.0% of the Initial Specified Amount.

facts.name: Year 4 Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: In Year 4, the Surrender Charge is 5.5% of the Initial Specified Amount.

facts.name: Year 5 Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: In Year 5, the Surrender Charge is 5.0% of the Initial Specified Amount.

facts.name: Year 6 Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: In Year 6, the Surrender Charge is 4.0% of the Initial Specified Amount.

facts.name: Year 7 Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: In Year 7, the Surrender Charge is 3.0% of the Initial Specified Amount.

facts.name: Year 8 Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: In Year 8, the Surrender Charge is 2.0% of the Initial Specified Amount.

facts.name: Year 9 Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: In Year 9, the Surrender Charge is 1.0% of the Initial Specified Amount.

facts.name: Zero Surrender Charge After Year 10
facts.sentence: From Year 10 onward, the Surrender Charge is 0% of the Initial Specified Amount.

facts.name: Surrender Charges Apply Despite SG
facts.sentence: If a policy is surrendered while the Special Guarantee (SG) is active, the surrender charge still applies.

facts.name: SG Prevents Lapse, Not Charges
facts.sentence: The Special Guarantee (SG) prevents policy lapse but does not waive surrender charges.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Trigger
facts.sentence: Death by suicide within 24 months of the issue date triggers a Suicide Exclusion.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Payout Limit
facts.sentence: Under the Suicide Exclusion, proceeds are limited to the Account Value as of the date of death.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion: No Surrender Charge Reduction
facts.sentence: Under the Suicide Exclusion, there is no surrender charge reduction applied.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Loan Deduction
facts.sentence: Under the Suicide Exclusion, proceeds are reduced by outstanding loans.

facts.name: Contestability Period
facts.sentence: This policy may be contested within 2 years of the issue date due to material misrepresentation.

facts.name: Aviation Hazard Exclusion
facts.sentence: An Aviation Hazard Exclusion applies if the insured dies as a result of operating or riding in any aircraft.

facts.name: Policy Contest Period
facts.sentence: We may contest this policy within 2 years of issue due to material misrepresentation.

facts.name: Aviation Exclusion Exception
facts.sentence: If the insured dies as a result of operating or riding in any aircraft, other than as a fare-paying passenger on a scheduled commercial airline, and that activity was noted in the application, no aviation exclusion applies.

facts.name: Non-Disclosure of Aviation Activity
facts.sentence: If aviation activity was not disclosed by the insured, we reserve the right to apply standard rescission.

facts.name: Tobacco Use Non-Disclosure
facts.sentence: If the insured uses tobacco within 3 years of the issue date and failed to disclose this, we may re-rate the policy at standard tobacco rates.

facts.name: Undisclosed Tobacco Use Penalty
facts.sentence: If the insured uses tobacco within 3 years of the issue date and failed to disclose this, we may collect the additional COI charge retroactively.

facts.name: Undisclosed Tobacco Use Penalty
facts.sentence: If the insured uses tobacco within 3 years of the issue date and failed to disclose this, we may reduce the death benefit accordingly.

facts.name: Grace Period Trigger
facts.sentence: If the actual Account Value is insufficient to cover monthly deductions and the Secondary Guarantee is not active, a 61-day grace period commences.

facts.name: No Grace Period with Active Guarantee
facts.sentence: If the Secondary Guarantee is active because the Shadow Account is greater than or equal to $0, no grace period is triggered.

facts.name: Policy Continuity via Shadow Account
facts.sentence: If the Secondary Guarantee is active because the Shadow Account is greater than or equal to $0, the policy remains in force regardless of actual Account Value.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requires Insurability Proof
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 3 years of lapse requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requirements
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 3 years of lapse requires payment of premium sufficient to restore the actual Account Value to a positive balance.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requires Shadow Account Restoration
facts.sentence: Reinstatement within 3 years of lapse requires payment of premium sufficient to restore the Shadow Account to a positive balance.

facts.name: Shadow Account Definition
facts.sentence: The Shadow Account is a separate hypothetical ledger.

facts.name: Shadow Account Initial Balance
facts.sentence: The Shadow Account begins at $0 on the issue date.

facts.name: Shadow Account Evolution
facts.sentence: The Shadow Account evolves over time according to specified rules.

facts.name: Shadow Account Definition
facts.sentence: The Shadow Account is a separate hypothetical ledger.

facts.name: Shadow Account Initialization
facts.sentence: The Shadow Account starts with a value of $0 on the issue date.

facts.name: Shadow Account Evolution Formula
facts.sentence: The Shadow Account evolves over time according to the formula: Shadow AV(n) = Shadow AV(n-1) + Shadow Premium Credit - Shadow COI Charge - Shadow Admin Charge + Shadow Interest Credit.

facts.name: Premium Credit Mechanism
facts.sentence: Each premium payment, net of a 3.5% load, is credited to the Shadow Account.

facts.name: Shadow Premium Credit Calculation
facts.sentence: Shadow Premium Credit is derived from each premium payment after deducting a 3.5% load.

facts.name: Shadow COI Rate Basis
facts.sentence: The Shadow COI Charge uses guaranteed maximum COI rates from the COI Schedule.

facts.name: Conservative COI Rate Assumption
facts.sentence: Guaranteed maximum COI rates from the COI Schedule are typically higher than current COI rates.

facts.name: Conservative Shadow Guarantee Design
facts.sentence: Using guaranteed maximum COI rates makes the Shadow Guarantee (SG) conservative.

facts.name: Guaranteed Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Shadow Interest is credited at a guaranteed annual rate of 3.75%.

facts.name: Guaranteed Shadow Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Shadow Interest is credited at 3.75% per annum regardless of the actual current interest rate.

facts.name: Shadow Admin Charge Amount
facts.sentence: The Shadow Admin Charge is $6.00 per month.

facts.name: Guaranteed Admin Charge
facts.sentence: The Shadow Admin Charge is guaranteed and does not vary.

facts.name: Secondary Guarantee Inactivation Condition
facts.sentence: If the Shadow Account Value is less than $0 on any Monthly Deduction Date, the Secondary Guarantee becomes immediately inactive.

facts.name: Secondary Guarantee Restoration Rule
facts.sentence: The Secondary Guarantee cannot be restored unless a catch-up premium payment is made.

facts.name: Catch-Up Payment Requirement
facts.sentence: A catch-up premium payment must be sufficient to bring the Shadow Account value back to $0 or more.

facts.name: Annual Balance Disclosure
facts.sentence: Shadow Account balance information will be provided in the annual policy statement.

facts.name: Document Execution Location
facts.sentence: The document was executed in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.

facts.name: CEO Signature Confirmation
facts.sentence: The Chief Executive Officer of Lakefront Mutual Life Insurance Company signed the document.

facts.name: Signature and Execution Date
facts.sentence: The signature appears on the document dated June 3, 2024.

facts.name: Mutual Company Structure
facts.sentence: Lakefront Mutual Life Insurance Company is a mutual company.

facts.name: Dividend Eligibility for Policyholders
facts.sentence: Policyholders of Lakefront Mutual Life Insurance Company may be eligible for annual dividends.

facts.name: Board Declaration of Dividends
facts.sentence: Dividends are subject to declaration by the Board of Lakefront Mutual Life Insurance Company.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Dividends
facts.sentence: Dividends are not guaranteed.

facts.name: Contract Identification
facts.sentence: The contract number for the life insurance policy is SHL-GUL-24-19203.

facts.name: Issue Date Confirmation
facts.sentence: The issue date of the life insurance policy is August 12, 2024.

facts.name: Policy Owner Identified
facts.sentence: The policy owner is Donna Jean Kowalski.

facts.name: Insured Person Identified
facts.sentence: The insured person is Donna Jean Kowalski.

facts.name: Female Insured Gender
facts.sentence: The gender of the insured is female.

facts.name: Date of Birth – Insured
facts.sentence: The date of birth of the insured is October 30, 1964.

facts.name: Current Insured Age
facts.sentence: The current age of the insured is 59 years old.

facts.name: Risk Classification: Standard Nonsmoker
facts.sentence: The risk class assigned to the insured is Standard Nonsmoker.

facts.name: Simplified Issue Underwriting
facts.sentence: The underwriting basis for the policy is Simplified Issue.

facts.name: No Medical Exam Required
facts.sentence: No medical examination is required for this policy.

facts.name: Max Simplified Issue Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum face amount eligible under Simplified Issue is $500,000.

facts.name: Face Value: $200,000
facts.sentence: The specified amount (face value) of the policy is $200,000.

facts.name: Fixed Monthly Premium
facts.sentence: The guarantee premium for the policy is $312.00 per month.

facts.name: Fixed Premium Guarantee
facts.sentence: The premium payment is fixed and does not change over time.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit Option
facts.sentence: The death benefit option selected is Level (Option A).

facts.name: Guaranteed Death Benefit Until Age 121
facts.sentence: The guaranteed death benefit period extends until the insured reaches age 121.

facts.name: Policy Maturity at Age 121
facts.sentence: The policy matures on the date when the insured turns age 121.

facts.name: Guaranteed Universal Life Product
facts.sentence: This policy is classified as a Guaranteed Universal Life insurance product.

facts.name: Guaranteed Death Benefit Protection
facts.sentence: The primary purpose of this policy is to provide guaranteed death benefit protection.

facts.name: Minimal Cash Value Accumulation
facts.sentence: Cash value accumulation within this policy is described as minimal.

facts.name: Secondary Cash Value Focus
facts.sentence: Cash value accumulation is considered secondary to death benefit protection in this policy.

facts.name: Cash Accumulation Limitation
facts.sentence: Individuals who seek significant cash value accumulation should consider alternative insurance products.

facts.name: Lifetime Death Benefit Guarantee
facts.sentence: The policy provides a lifetime death benefit guarantee.

facts.name: Minimal Cash Accumulation
facts.sentence: Cash value accumulation in the policy is minimal.

facts.name: Death Benefit Priority
facts.sentence: Cash value accumulation is secondary to the death benefit guarantee.

facts.name: Cash Accumulation Limitation
facts.sentence: Policyholders who seek significant cash accumulation should consider other products.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary is Donald R. Kowalski.

facts.name: Spouse Designation
facts.sentence: Donald R. Kowalski is designated as the husband of the insured.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Payout
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary receives 100% of the death benefit.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary is the Kowalski Family Revocable Living Trust.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Payout Rule
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary receives 100% of the death benefit if the primary beneficiary predeceases the insured.

facts.name: Guarantee Premium Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Guarantee Premium' refers to the fixed monthly premium listed on the Policy Data Page.

facts.name: Guarantee Premium Maintenance
facts.sentence: Payment of the Guarantee Premium on time and in full maintains the Lifetime Death Benefit Guarantee.

facts.name: Death Benefit Guarantee Stability
facts.sentence: The Lifetime Death Benefit Guarantee remains active regardless of Account Value, provided all Guarantee Premiums are paid on time.

facts.name: Account Value Definition
facts.sentence: An 'Account Value' is defined as the accumulation of net premiums credited with interest minus charges.

facts.name: Zero Account Value During Policy Life
facts.sentence: Account Value can be zero or near-zero at various times during the policy’s life.

facts.name: Zero Account Value No Lapse
facts.sentence: A zero or near-zero Account Value does not cause the policy to lapse while the Lifetime Guarantee is active.

facts.name: Lifetime Death Benefit Guarantee
facts.sentence: The 'Lifetime Death Benefit Guarantee' is a contractual obligation to pay the Specified Amount upon the death of the Insured.

facts.name: Timely Premium Payment Requirement
facts.sentence: The Lifetime Death Benefit Guarantee applies only if all Guarantee Premiums have been paid on time.

facts.name: Death Benefit Independence
facts.sentence: The Lifetime Death Benefit Guarantee operates independently of Account Value.

facts.name: Guarantee Reset Adjustment
facts.sentence: A 'Guarantee Reset' refers to the adjustment of the Guarantee Premium after a permitted change event.

facts.name: Simplified Issue Underwriting
facts.sentence: 'Simplified Issue' describes an underwriting method based solely on application questions and database checks.

facts.name: No Medical Exam Required
facts.sentence: Simplified Issue does not require a medical examination.

facts.name: No Attending Physician Statement Required
facts.sentence: Simplified Issue does not require an attending physician statement.

facts.name: Fixed Guarantee Premium
facts.sentence: The Guarantee Premium is fixed at the amount shown on the Policy Data Page for the life of the policy.

facts.name: Fixed Premium Over Time
facts.sentence: The Guarantee Premium will not increase due to age.

facts.name: Fixed Premium Despite Health Changes
facts.sentence: The Guarantee Premium will not increase due to health changes.

facts.name: Fixed Premium Stability
facts.sentence: The Guarantee Premium will not increase due to interest rate movements.

facts.name: Monthly Payment Deadline
facts.sentence: The Guarantee Premium must be received by the insurer on or before the Monthly Due Date.

facts.name: Monthly Due Date
facts.sentence: The Monthly Due Date is the 12th of each month.

facts.name: Tolerance Window for Payments
facts.sentence: A 30-day tolerance window is allowed for receiving the Guarantee Premium.

facts.name: Tolerance Window for Guarantee Continuity
facts.sentence: If a Guarantee Premium is paid within 30 days after its Monthly Due Date, the Guarantee is considered uninterrupted.

facts.name: Guarantee Suspension Condition
facts.sentence: If a Guarantee Premium is more than 30 days late, the Lifetime Guarantee is suspended.

facts.name: Suspension of Lifetime Guarantee
facts.sentence: Article 10 provides further details regarding Suspension of the Lifetime Guarantee.

facts.name: Annual Payment Option
facts.sentence: The Guarantee Premium may be redirected to be paid annually.

facts.name: Annual Guarantee Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual Guarantee Premium amount is $3,489.00.

facts.name: Annual Payment Discount
facts.sentence: An annual payment receives a 6.5% discount.

facts.name: Guarantee Premium Payment Options
facts.sentence: The Guarantee Premium may be redirected to be paid semi-annually.

facts.name: Semi-Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The semi-annual Guarantee Premium amount is $1,791.00.

facts.name: Semi-Annual Payment Discount
facts.sentence: A semi-annual payment receives a 3.5% discount.

facts.name: Quarterly Payment Option
facts.sentence: The Guarantee Premium may be redirected to be paid quarterly.

facts.name: Quarterly Guarantee Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The quarterly Guarantee Premium amount is $917.00.

facts.name: Quarterly Payment Discount
facts.sentence: A quarterly payment receives a 1.5% discount.

facts.name: Monthly Payment Option
facts.sentence: The Guarantee Premium may be paid monthly.

facts.name: Monthly Guarantee Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The monthly Guarantee Premium amount is $312.00.

facts.name: No Discount for Monthly Payments
facts.sentence: Monthly payments receive no discount.

facts.name: Excess Premium Allocation
facts.sentence: Premiums in excess of the Guarantee Premium are applied to increase Account Value.

fact_fact.label: influences
fact_fact.description: Additional non-medical requirements for high face amounts ($>250k) imply that the fixed Guarantee Premium may only apply under specific eligibility conditions tied to those thresholds.

fact_fact.label: referred to by
fact_fact.description: The policy form SHL-GUL-2024 establishes the contractual basis for insurance provisions, including the rule requiring payment of missed premiums within six months of suspension, as stated in fact_sentence_1.

fact_fact.label: referred to by
fact_fact.description: The policy form SHL-GUL-2024 governs the terms under which reinstatement conditions—such as the 6% interest on missed premiums—are applied when a guarantee is suspended.

fact_fact.label: referred to by
fact_fact.description: The policy form SHL-GUL-2024 establishes the framework for reinstatement conditions, such as the requirement for no evidence of insurability within six months after suspension, as detailed in fact_sentence_1.

fact_fact.label: applies to
fact_fact.description: Policy Form SHL-GUL-2024 governs the terms of reinstatement, including the requirement for evidence of insurability after six months of suspension, as detailed in fact_sentence_1.

fact_fact.label: referred to by
fact_fact.description: The SHL-GUL-2024 policy form governs the rules around reinstatement, including possible premium resets after six months of suspension.

fact_fact.label: implied by
fact_fact.description: The use of policy form SHL-GUL-2024 implies standardized terms and conditions that would have been approved and potentially signed off on by authorized personnel such as the President.

fact_fact.label: defined by
fact_fact.description: The policy form SHL-GUL-2024 establishes the framework for coverage limits, including setting the Simplified Issue Maximum at $500,000.

fact_fact.label: applies to
fact_fact.description: Policy Form SHL-GUL-2024 establishes the framework that includes special non-medical requirements for face amounts above $250,000, directly supporting the condition stated in fact_sentence_1.

fact_fact.label: enables
fact_fact.description: Policy Form SHL-GUL-2024 includes provisions ensuring the Lifetime Death Benefit Guarantee remains active only when the Guarantee Premium is paid promptly and fully, making the timing of payments essential to uphold the guarantee.

fact_fact.label: enables
fact_fact.description: Policy Form SHL-GUL-2024 enables the Lifetime Death Benefit Guarantee by establishing the framework—such as premium timing and reinstatement rules—that ensures the guarantee remains effective upon proper payment compliance.

fact_fact.label: enforces condition
fact_fact.description: Policy Form SHL-GUL-2024 includes provisions ensuring the lifetime death benefit guarantee remains active only when all guarantee premiums are paid on time, thus embedding the condition stated in fact_sentence_1 into its contractual terms.

fact_fact.label: enables
fact_fact.description: The policy form SHL-GUL-2024 specifies the mechanism for maintaining the Guarantee Premium through defined payment schedules and reinstatement policies.

facts.sentence: The risk class of the insured is Preferred Plus Nonsmoker.

facts.name: Target Monthly Premium
facts.sentence: The target premium payment is $1,500 per month.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit Option
facts.sentence: The death benefit option selected is Level (Option A).

facts.name: Tax-Advantaged Accumulation
facts.sentence: The design purpose of the policy is tax-advantaged cash accumulation with incidental death benefit protection.

facts.name: 7-Pay Test Threshold
facts.sentence: The 7-pay test amount is $18,000 per year.

facts.name: Premium Threshold Trigger
facts.sentence: If premiums exceed $18,000 in any given year, the policy will be classified as a Modified Endowment Contract.

facts.name: MEC Warning Trigger Condition
facts.sentence: The insurer will provide MEC warnings when premiums exceed the 7-pay test threshold.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: Claire Beatrice Prescott is the primary beneficiary.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Allocation
facts.sentence: Claire Beatrice Prescott's share of the benefit is 100%.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary is The Prescott Trust.

facts.name: Prescott Trust Establishment Date

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: The Prescott Trust’s share of the benefit is 100%.

facts.name: Account Value Definition
facts.sentence: Account Value refers to the accumulated fund within this policy.

facts.name: Account Value Definition
facts.sentence: Account Value equals the sum of net premiums credited with interest.

facts.name: Account Value Reduction
facts.sentence: Account Value is reduced by monthly charges.

facts.name: HECV Feature Definition
facts.sentence: High Early Cash Value (HECV) is a feature of this policy design.

facts.name: Inverted Surrender Charge Structure
facts.sentence: HECV involves an inverted surrender charge structure compared to conventional universal life products.

facts.name: HECV Liquidity Benefit
facts.sentence: HECV creates greater liquidity during the early years of the policy.

facts.name: Target Premium Definition
facts.sentence: Target Premium is the planned premium amount used in pricing the HECV feature.

facts.name: Underfunding Reduces HECV Benefits
facts.sentence: Premiums below the Target Premium in the first five years may reduce HECV benefits.

facts.name: Overfund Amount Definition
facts.sentence: Overfund Amount refers to premiums paid above the Target Premium in a given year.

facts.name: Overfund Limits Under IRC §7702
facts.sentence: Overfund Amount is subject to Internal Revenue Code Section 7702 limits.

facts.name: Definition of COI
facts.sentence: COI stands for Cost of Insurance.

facts.name: Monthly COI Charge
facts.sentence: COI occurs on a monthly basis.

facts.name: Flexible Premium Payments
facts.sentence: Premiums can be paid at any time.

facts.name: Minimum Payment Requirement
facts.sentence: Minimum premium payment is $200 per payment.

facts.name: Annual Premium Limit
facts.sentence: Annual maximum premium payment is the Guideline Annual Premium under IRC §7702.

facts.name: Insurer Calculates Guideline Premium
facts.sentence: The insurer will calculate the Guideline Annual Premium.

facts.name: Insurer Communication of GAP
facts.sentence: The insurer will communicate the Guideline Annual Premium.

facts.name: Flexible Premium Payments
facts.sentence: Premiums may be paid at any time.

facts.name: Minimum Premium Payment
facts.sentence: The minimum premium payment is $200 per payment.

facts.name: Annual Premium Limit Rule
facts.sentence: The annual maximum premium payment is determined by the Guideline Annual Premium per IRC §7702.

facts.name: Annual Max Premium Limit Calculation
facts.sentence: The insurer will calculate and communicate the annual maximum premium limit each year.

facts.name: Premium Expense Load Rate
facts.sentence: On premiums up to the Target Premium, the premium expense load is 4.0%.

facts.name: Overfund Expense Load Rate
facts.sentence: On Overfund Amounts above the Target Premium, the premium expense load is 1.5%.

facts.name: Lower Load Incentivizes Overfunding
facts.sentence: The lower premium expense load on overfunded amounts incentivizes higher contributions.

facts.name: Overfunding Growth Incentive
facts.sentence: Higher contributions encourage accelerated tax-sheltered growth.

facts.name: Overfunding Strategy Intent
facts.sentence: This policy is designed for owners who wish to 'stuff' the policy with premiums.

facts.name: Overfunding for Retirement Growth
facts.sentence: The purpose of stuffing the policy is to grow a tax-deferred, potentially tax-free supplemental retirement fund.

facts.name: Advisor Recommendation for Premium Optimization
facts.sentence: It is recommended to work with a financial advisor to optimize premium levels.

facts.name: Avoid MEC Status via Optimization
facts.sentence: Optimizing premium levels helps avoid triggering Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) status.

facts.name: Premium Skip Flexibility
facts.sentence: Skipping premiums is permitted.

facts.name: Premium Skip Condition
facts.sentence: Skipping premiums is allowed provided the Account Value exceeds six months of projected monthly deductions.

facts.name: No Surrender Charges Years 1–5
facts.sentence: Unlike conventional Universal Life products, this policy has no surrender charge in years 1 through 5.

facts.name: Minimal Surrender Charge Condition
facts.sentence: A minimal surrender charge applies if the policy is surrendered in years 6–10.

facts.name: Surrender Charge Condition
facts.sentence: The surrender charge applies only when the Account Value is below the cumulative Target Premiums paid.

facts.name: Year 6 Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: In year 6, the surrender charge is 3.0% of the shortfall.

facts.name: Year 7 Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: In year 7, the surrender charge is 2.5% of the shortfall.

facts.name: Year 8 Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: In year 8, the surrender charge is 2.0% of the shortfall.

facts.name: Year 9 Surrender Charge Rate
facts.sentence: In year 9, the surrender charge is 1.0% of the shortfall.

facts.name: Zero Surrender Charge After Year 10
facts.sentence: From year 10 onward, the surrender charge is 0%.

facts.name: Shortfall Definition
facts.sentence: The 'shortfall' is defined as cumulative Target Premiums minus actual premiums paid.

facts.name: No Surrender Charge with Target Payments
facts.sentence: If the owner pays the Target Premium consistently, there is no surrender charge in any policy year.

facts.name: HECV Feature Funding Mechanism
facts.sentence: The High Early Cash Value (HECV) feature is funded by a slightly higher Cost of Insurance (COI) charge.

facts.name: Higher COI Charge
facts.sentence: The COI charge for this product is higher than that of conventional products with the same face amount.

facts.name: Higher COI for V Feature
facts.sentence: The V feature is funded by a slightly higher COI charge compared to conventional products of the same face amount.

facts.name: Monthly COI Deduction
facts.sentence: On the 9th of each month, a Cost of Insurance charge is deducted from Account Value.

facts.name: Monthly Admin Fee Deduction
facts.sentence: On the 9th of each month, an Administrative fee of $10.00 per month is deducted from Account Value.

facts.name: Monthly Loan Interest Deduction
facts.sentence: On the 9th of each month, outstanding loan interest is deducted from Account Value.

facts.name: COI Basis: 2017 CSO Preferred Plus
facts.sentence: The COI basis used is the 2017 CSO Preferred Plus Table.

facts.name: HECV Self-Selection Advantage
facts.sentence: The COI rates are competitive due to the HECV design self-selecting for healthy, financially sophisticated insureds.

facts.name: COI Calculation Formula
facts.sentence: Monthly COI is calculated using the formula: (Specified Amount - Account Value) × COI Rate / 1,000.

facts.name: Account Value Accumulation Design
facts.sentence: This policy is designed to accumulate significant Account Value.

facts.name: Decreasing Net Risk Over Time
facts.sentence: As Account Value approaches the Specified Amount, the net amount at risk decreases over time.

facts.name: Declining COI Over Time
facts.sentence: Because the net amount at risk decreases over time, the COI also decreases over time.

facts.name: Daily Interest Crediting
facts.sentence: Interest is credited daily.

facts.name: Guaranteed Minimum Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The guaranteed minimum annual interest rate is 2.00%.

facts.name: Current Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The current annual interest rate is 5.00%.

facts.name: Interest Rate Tiers Below $100K
facts.sentence: For Account Values less than $100,000, the interest credit rate is the current rate of 5.00%.

facts.name: Enhanced Interest Tier: $100K–$499K
facts.sentence: For Account Values between $100,000 and $499,999 inclusive, the interest credit rate is the current rate plus 0.25%, resulting in 5.25%.

facts.name: Enhanced Interest Tiers
facts.sentence: For Account Values greater than or equal to $500,000, the interest credit rate is the current rate plus 0.50%, resulting in 5.50%.

facts.name: Tiered Interest Guarantee
facts.sentence: The tiered rate differential is guaranteed to be at least

facts.name: AV Threshold Rate Increase
facts.sentence: AV ≥ $500,000 results in a current rate plus 0.50%, totaling 5.50%.

facts.name: Guaranteed Rate Differential
facts.sentence: Tiered rate differential is guaranteed to be at least +0.10%.

facts.name: Guaranteed Rate Differential
facts.sentence: Tiered rate differential is guaranteed to be at least +0.20%.

facts.name: Monthly Rate Crediting
facts.sentence: Interest rate is declared and credited in arrears each month.

facts.name: Monthly Rate Adjustment
facts.sentence: Interest rate may change from month to month.

facts.name: Death Benefit Calculation Formula
facts.sentence: Death Benefit equals the greater of (a) Specified Amount or (b) Account Value multiplied by applicable corridor percentage per IRC §7702(d).

facts.name: Corridor Percentage Based on Age
facts.sentence: Applicable corridor percentage is determined based on the insured's attained age.

facts.name: Option A Active Status
facts.sentence: Option A is currently in force.

facts.name: Corridor Excess Death Benefit
facts.sentence: As Account Value grows, the IRC §7702 corridor may cause the death benefit to temporarily exceed the Specified Amount.

facts.name: Corridor Benefit Cost-Free
facts.sentence: The 'corridor' benefit is provided at no additional cost.

facts.name: Policy Endowment Trigger
facts.sentence: If Account Value reaches the Specified Amount, the policy becomes treated as an endowment for IRC purposes.

facts.name: Pre-endowment Notification
facts.sentence: We will notify the Owner prior to the policy being treated as an endowment.

facts.name: Death Proceeds Payment Timeline
facts.sentence: Death proceeds are paid within 14 business days after receipt of required documentation.

facts.name: Minimum Withdrawal Amount
facts.sentence: Minimum withdrawal amount is $500.

facts.name: No Annual Withdrawal Limit
facts.sentence: There is no annual limit on maximum withdrawal per year.

facts.name: Minimum Post-Withdrawal Balance
facts.sentence: A minimum of $5,000 must remain in the Account Value after any withdrawal.

facts.name: No Withdrawal Fees
facts.sentence: No withdrawal fee applies in any policy year.

facts.name: Tax-Free Withdrawal Limits
facts.sentence: Withdrawals are income-tax-free up to the amount that does not exceed the policy.

facts.name: No Annual Withdrawal Limit
facts.sentence: There is no annual limit on withdrawals.

facts.name: No Annual Limit With Minimum Balance
facts.sentence: The absence of an annual limit is subject to a minimum remaining Account Value of $5,000.

facts.name: No Withdrawal Fee
facts.sentence: No withdrawal fee applies in any policy year.

facts.name: Tax-Free Withdrawal Limit
facts.sentence: Withdrawals are income-tax-free up to the amount that does not exceed the policy 'basis'.

facts.name: Policy Basis Definition
facts.sentence: The policy 'basis' is defined as total premiums paid minus prior distributions.

facts.name: Tax-Free Withdrawal Rules
facts.sentence: The tax-free status of withdrawals is governed by Internal Revenue Code section 72(e).

facts.name: Tax-Free Withdrawals Up to Basis
facts.sentence: The tax-free nature of withdrawals up to the basis is a key planning feature.

facts.name: MEC Distributions Income-First Rule
facts.sentence: For Modified Endowment Contract (MEC)-classified policies, all distributions are treated as income first.

facts.name: Distributions Scope Clarification
facts.sentence: This includes both withdrawals and other types of distributions.

facts.name: Account Value Reduction
facts.sentence: Withdrawals permanently reduce the Account Value.

facts.name: Withdrawal Reduces Cost Basis
facts.sentence: Withdrawals permanently reduce the Owner's cost basis.

facts.name: Maximum Loan Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum loan allowed is 95% of the Account Value.

facts.name: Higher Loan Cap Advantage
facts.sentence: The 95% loan cap is higher than that offered by conventional products.

facts.name: High Loan Cap Purpose
facts.sentence: The purpose of the high loan cap is to maximize access to retirement income distribution.

facts.name: Standard Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: A standard loan charges interest at the Prime Rate plus 0.50%.

facts.name: Standard Loan Minimum Rate
facts.sentence: The minimum interest rate for a standard loan is 3.50%.

facts.name: Standard Loan Earnings Guarantee
facts.sentence: The borrowed amount under a standard loan earns a guaranteed minimum rate of 2.00%.

facts.name: Participating Loan Availability
facts.sentence: A participating loan is available starting from policy year 1.

facts.name: Participating Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Interest on a participating loan is fixed at 4.00%.

facts.name: Participating Loan Growth Benefit
facts.sentence: The borrowed amount under a participating loan continues to earn the full credited interest rate.

facts.name: Participating Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The current credited interest rate for the loaned amount is 5.00%.

facts.name: Participating Loan Net Gain
facts.sentence: A participating loan can result in a potential net gain on the loan cost.

facts.name: Non-MEC Loans Not Taxable Income
facts.sentence: Policy loans from a non-MEC policy are not considered income.

facts.name: Tax-Free Policy Loans (Non-MEC)
facts.sentence: Policy loans from a non-MEC policy are generally income-tax-free if the policy remains in force.

facts.name: Taxable Event Upon Lapse
facts.sentence: Surrendering or lapsing a policy with outstanding loans may trigger a taxable event.

facts.name: High Loan Risk & Lapse Exposure
facts.sentence: Borrowing 95% of the Account Value significantly increases the risk of policy lapse.

facts.name: Annual Loan Statements Provided
facts.sentence: Annual loan statements will be provided to the policyholder.

facts.name: Illustration Preparation Request
facts.sentence: We may prepare a non-guaranteed illustration upon request.

facts.name: Withdrawals and Loans for Tax-Advantaged Income
facts.sentence: The illustration shows how combinations of withdrawals (to basis) and loans can generate tax-advantaged income in retirement.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Assumptions
facts.sentence: All illustrations use non-guaranteed current assumptions.

facts.name: Interest Rate Variability
facts.sentence: Actual results will vary based on interest rates.

facts.name: COI Charges Impact
facts.sentence: Actual results will vary based on COI charges.

facts.name: Premium History Impact
facts.sentence: Actual results will vary based on premium history.

facts.name: Illustrations Not Contracts
facts.sentence: Illustrations are not contracts.

facts.name: Illustrations Not Guarantees
facts.sentence: Illustrations are not guarantees.

facts.name: Illustration Regulatory Oversight
facts.sentence: Such illustrations are governed by the NAIC Life Insurance Illustration Model Regulation.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Trigger
facts.sentence: Death by suicide within 24 months triggers a suicide exclusion.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Payout
facts.sentence: Under the suicide exclusion, the account value as of the date of death is paid without interest.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Loan Deduction
facts.sentence: Under the suicide exclusion, outstanding loans are deducted from the account value.

facts.name: Contestability Period Duration
facts.sentence: Contestability lasts for 2 years from the issue date.

facts.name: Specified Amount Increase Reset
facts.sentence: Any increase in the Specified Amount restarts the contestability period for the increased portion.

facts.name: Suicide Period Reset on Increase
facts.sentence: Any increase in the Specified Amount restarts the suicide period for the increased portion.

facts.name: Insufficient Funds Notification Trigger
facts.sentence: If the Account Value is insufficient to cover 3 months of monthly deductions, we notify the Owner.

facts.name: Grace Period Trigger Condition
facts.sentence: A 61-day grace period follows when the Account Value is insufficient to cover 3 months of monthly deductions.

facts.name: Cash Surrender on Lapse
facts.sentence: Upon lapse, any Account Value exceeding outstanding loans is paid as a Cash Surrender Value.

facts.name: No Surrender Charge Condition
facts.sentence: No surrender charge applies if the Owner has paid Target Premiums in all prior years.

facts.name: Grace Period Provision
facts.sentence: A grace period follows the policy.

facts.name: Cash Surrender on Lapse
facts.sentence: Upon lapse, any Account Value that exceeds outstanding loans is paid as a Cash Surrender Value.

facts.name: No Surrender Charge Condition
facts.sentence: No surrender charge applies if the Owner has paid Target Premiums in all prior years.

facts.name: Lapse Tax Consequence
facts.sentence: If this policy lapses or is surrendered with outstanding loans exceeding cost basis, the excess amount is treated as ordinary income in the year of lapse.

facts.name: Tax Implications of Policy Lapse
facts.sentence: Individuals should consult a tax advisor regarding the tax implications of policy lapse or surrender when outstanding loans exceed cost basis.

facts.sentence: BlueStar Financial Life Company offers products through licensed insurance agents only.
